svg.title: MetPipe Northeast: twenty-station observation network
svg.desc: Twenty airport stations in Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, Vermont, New Hampshire, Maine and New York. All stations use the same blue circle, including Provincetown. Historical database scope: 2005–2024; records have gaps.
svg.text: 20 stations · Regional observation network · Historical scope: 2005–2024
